description: This Java class defines the SparkplugTopic, representing MQTT topics for Sparkplug in the context of Thingsboard. It includes constructors, parsing logic, and utility methods related to Sparkplug MQTT topics.

classes.name: SparkplugTopic
classes.description: Represents a Sparkplug MQTT topic with various constructors, parsing, and utility methods.

methods.name: parseTopic
methods.description: Parses a topic string into a SparkplugTopic object, throwing exception on invalid format.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace version of the Sparkplug topic.

methods.name: getSparkplugDescriptor
methods.description: Returns the SparkplugDescriptor associated with the topic.

methods.name: getEdgeNodeDescriptor
methods.description: Returns the EdgeNodeDescriptor associated with the topic.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the group ID of the topic.

methods.name: getHostApplicationId
methods.description: Returns the host application ID if applicable.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the topic.

methods.name: isType
methods.description: Checks if the topic's message type matches the given type.

methods.name: isNode
methods.description: Checks if the topic is a node (not a device).

methods.name: getNodeDeviceName
methods.description: Returns node or device name based on type.

methods.name: isValidIdElementToUTF8
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid UTF8 ID element for Sparkplug.
